GET STARTED Match Replays SUBSCRIBE Bayern vs. Real Madrid Bayern outplayed Real Madrid for long stretches of the first leg away, scoring twice, but the opponents are very much alive thanks to Mbappé's goal. 1H 37M Apr 15, 2026 SUBSCRIBE Arsenal vs. Sporting CP Sporting CP put up a strong fight in London, but they were denied multiple times, and Arsenal eventually prevailed thanks to a very late game-winner. 1H 37M Apr 15, 2026 SUBSCRIBE Atlético Madrid vs. Barcelona Barcelona have their backs against the wall as Atlético Madrid took advantage of an early red card and built a two-goal advantage at the Camp Nou. 1H 44M Apr 14, 2026 SUBSCRIBE Liverpool vs. PSG PSG ran the show at the Parc des Princes, but the qualification is still open, as they squandered a few chances to round out the two-nil result. 1H 42M Apr 14, 2026 SUBSCRIBE PSG vs. Liverpool PSG sweated more in the derby with Monaco in the playoff than versus Chelsea, which they crushed, while Liverpool tamed Galatasaray in the return leg. 1H 35M Apr 8, 2026 SUBSCRIBE Barcelona vs. Atlético Madrid La Liga rivals face off in the quarter-finals after Barcelona routed Newcastle United and Atlético Madrid topped Club Brugge and Tottenham. 1H 39M Apr 8, 2026 SUBSCRIBE Real Madrid vs. Bayern Two of the top contenders meet in the Round of Eight already after Real Madrid ousted Man. City convincingly and Bayern demolished Atalanta. 1H 37M Apr 7, 2026 SUBSCRIBE Sporting CP vs. Arsenal Sporting CP pulled off an improbable comeback against Bodø/Glimt after losing three-nil in Norway, while Arsenal handled Bayer Leverkusen at home. 1H 35M Apr 7, 2026 SUBSCRIBE Bayern vs. Atalanta Bayern were no match for Atalanta in the opening match in Bergamo, as their attackers ran amok all game long and hung six goals on the opponents. 1H 37M Mar 18, 2026 SUBSCRIBE Tottenham vs. Atlético Madrid Tottenham gift-wrapped three early goals to the opponents because of blunders, and Atlético Madrid cruised to a 5-2 victory in Madrid. 1H 39M Mar 18, 2026 Show More Beckham & Friends Live Highlights Champions League Today Post-Match Interviews UCL Best Moments UCL Specials Destination London You May Also Like UEFA Champions League Every pass.
